import pandas as pd

# Compute total per city

# Show sorted ascending by Total for clarity

print(result)

```python
import pandas as pd

file_path = '/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/7cc4acfa-63fd-4acc-a1a1-e8e529e0a97f.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(file_path)

sales_cols = ['Burgers','Hot Dogs','Salads','Fries','Ice Cream','Soda']

# Group by Location, sum item columns, then compute grand total
grp = df.groupby('Location')[sales_cols].sum()
grp['GrandTotal'] = grp.sum(axis=1)

# Filter to the two cities
focus = grp.loc[['Wharvton','Algrimand']]

# Sort ascending by GrandTotal and print
sorted_focus = focus[['GrandTotal']].sort_values('GrandTotal', ascending=True)
print('Grand totals for selected cities (sorted ascending by GrandTotal):')
print(sorted_focus)

# Also provide a dictionary mapping
totals_dict = focus['GrandTotal'].to_dict()
print('Totals dict:', totals_dict)
```
